changes.comment: ai-assist: new resolveMaxOutputTokens(descriptor, modelId) returns a model's maximum output tokens (the largest maxTokens the provider accepts), or undefined when unknown. Alias-first and longest-prefix, like resolveStructuredOutputCapability. Declared through a new optional IAiProviderDescriptor.maxOutputTokens array of IAiMaxOutputTokensCapability. The shipped registry records Anthropic and OpenAI completion models from their provider pages and declares no catch-all. No request behaviour changes: an explicit maxTokens is not clamped, and DEFAULT_ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS (4096) is below every recorded Anthropic limit.
